input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: No minimum purchase, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-commitment obligation is imposed on Sparkling anywhere in the Agreement. Fees are payable only as set out in the Fee Schedule for the licence and services actually taken (§ 11, p0084), additional-location use triggers fees only if Sparkling elects to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations (§ 2, p0028), and maintenance runs on a "renewable one-year term" rather than a multi-year committed term (§ 10, p0065). Sparkling also holds an unconditional right to terminate at any time on ninety days' notice (§ 17(b), p0118), so there is no multi-year commitment without an exit. The only volume-type constraints are copy/location restrictions on licence scope, which are not Customer purchase commitments. This meets the preferred position; the Fee Schedule (Schedule "A") is not reproduced in the document, so we would confirm on review that it contains no committed seat, location or maintenance-year minimums.
